title: IG caption and reel copy
summary: Write a new Instagram caption or reel script in an account's usual style, then check its grammar and that it suits a school's audience and voice.

steps.title: Write the caption
steps.goal: Write a new caption or reel script that follows the account's usual style: length, emoji, hashtags, language mix, opening, sign-off and call to action
steps.note: Paste 8 to 10 recent captions from the account. Ask the model to describe their pattern first, then write. The examples matter more than the model pick.

steps.title: Check the grammar
steps.goal: Find grammar, spelling, punctuation and word-choice errors in the script and caption, and suggest a fix for each without rewriting the voice
steps.note: Use a fresh chat. Ask for a list of errors with a fix for each, not a rewritten script. A flattering model calls a weak draft great, so low Sycophantic matters almost as much as Literate.

steps.title: Check the fit for the reel
steps.goal: Judge whether the script sounds natural spoken aloud, strikes the right tone for parents and students, avoids generic school-marketing filler, and flags anything sensitive
steps.other_checks: AA-PersonalityBench is in English. For Indonesian or mixed-language reels, try three or four real scripts on the top picks first.
steps.note: Use a different model from step 1, so the writer doesn't judge its own draft. Paste the school's own checklist into the prompt: brand voice, faith-based wording, claims about results, and consent for any child's face or name. That checklist matters more than the model pick.
